keys.label: Ready

keys.caption: Tossing arm at full stretch, ball released

keys.label: Trophy
keys.caption: Deepest leg load, racket up behind you, tossing arm reaching up

keys.caption: Racket head falls behind the back

keys.label: Contact
keys.caption: Full extension, highest point of the swing

keys.label: Finish
keys.caption: Swing across the body, landing inside the court
